groups.sentence: Instructors and teaching staff understand the limitations of AI and use their judgment when relying on it.
AI-generated content, including code, may be of low quality, inaccurate or not meet standards for a passing grade.
Students modify and improve AI output, since it is unlikely to be quality work.
AI struggles with deep understanding, synthesis and higher-level tasks, and gives less original results.
Everyone using generative AI is responsible for understanding its capabilities, limits and risks and for using it appropriately.
Students understand what AI tools can and cannot do, including their limitations.
AI cannot access recent events or paywalled and subscription resources.
